claim_1.claim: RNA sequencing analysis of CD8+ T cells from 40 hospitalized dengue patients showed distinct transcriptomic profiles between early (4-7 days post fever onset) and late (8+ days post fever onset) phases, but no differences based on disease severity (DF vs DHF).

sources.quote: In the next series of experiments, we explored the signatures associated with the DENV-specific CD8+ IFNγ+ response in early (4-7 days PFO) versus late (8+ days PFO) samples, reflective of acute and convalescent phase samples.
A total of 352 genes were differentially expressed, with 167 genes upregulated in the early response and 185 genes upregulated in the late response (Figure 4a,b).

comparison.finding: A total of 352 genes were differentially expressed, with 167 genes upregulated in the early response and 185 genes upregulated in the late response (Figure 4a,b).

claim_2.claim: RNA sequencing analysis of DENV-specific CD8+ T cells between IFN-γ+ CD8+ T cells and IFNγ− CD8+ T cells.

sources.quote: a total of 1806 DE genes were identified, based on the log2 fold change (LFC) > 1.5 or <−1.5 and with p adjusted value (padj) < 0.05.

comparison.finding: a total of 1806 DE genes were identified, based on the log2 fold change (LFC) > 1.5 or <−1.5 and with p adjusted value (padj) < 0.05
